why: Computer Use may now act in cmux itself (Leo, 2026-11-22: "why not. it should be able to"), so Settings > Computer Use must take only the person's own HID input. The rule lives in CmuxNextPages (PageCallContext.requirePerson) and CmuxNextSettings (ComputerUseSettings.isPersonOnly); App keeps one call per op (set, reset, preview, reset_all, the --confirm sheet, Saved approvals) because only App holds the page call context and AppServices.personInput. widen() moved onto the same helper (-4 lines).
